name: problem-callouts
description: Problem section: centred heading and lede over a photo ringed by floating callout chips, a closing note and a panda CTA bar. Live: the `.ap-problem` section on every vertical and hub page.

kicker.description: Bold line under the lede, e.g. That works — until it doesn't.

image.description: Photo at the centre of the stage.

background.description: Soft background image behind the section.

cards.description: Callout chips around the photo; the first five take the design's placements. Each: text (required); optional icon (URL), icon_svg (inline SVG), icon_alt and tone (indigo, rose, mint, slate, amber).

cta_accent.description: Second line of the CTA heading, painted with the brand gradient.

cta_logo.description: Small mark beside the CTA copy: a file in assets/ or a URL.

cta_label.description: CTA button text. Renders only with cta_url.
